title: FLARE v7.14 Oregon public demonstration sample, July 16, 2026, 18:01–18:26 UTC
description: Public demonstration subset: six experimental native-grid scenes for July 16, 2026, 18:01–18:26 UTC inclusive, at five-minute intervals. NetCDF4 preserves source values on a 545 by 1425 grid. Includes Python/Jupyter examples. The full 25-scene dataset is published separately with restricted files at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23304444; the remaining 19 scenes are not included here. This metadata describes the public GitHub subset, not the restricted Zenodo record. Reconstructed values are not direct VIIRS observations. Radiance physical units remain unverified. FireScore is not a probability.
